        "description": "the selector-map index of the target input element",
        "type": "integer"
      },

        "description": "the text to type into the element",

# example dispatch
call: search({"query":"hacker news"})
result: top 3 hits for "hacker news": example.com/hacker news, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/hacker news, github.com/search?q=hacker news
